dimensions.assessment: Negligible direct population effect, limited to diplomatic staff and record-keeping personnel.
dimensions.evidence: To designate a building of the Chancery of the United States in Pristina, Kosovo, as the ``Eliot L. Engel Building''.
The building of the Chancery of the United States located at Arberia, Nr.25 Rr. 4 KORRIKU in Pristina, Kosovo, shall be designated as the ``Eliot L. Engel Building''.

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, appropriations, or economic effects are mentioned.
Applies solely to the naming of a single overseas building.
dimensions.evidence: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the building referred to in section 1 shall be deemed to be a reference to the ``Eliot L. Engel Building''.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent naming designation for the building.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill designates a specific United States Chancery building in Pristina, Kosovo, after an individual, resulting in administrative name changes in records.
